name: search-console-health
summary: One Search Console property's health on your own Google account: clicks and impressions for the last 28 days against the 28 before, top queries and pages, sitemap errors, the home page's index status, and plain findings.

site.note: the property as Search Console names it: sc-domain:example.com, or https://www.example.com/

inspect_url.note: one page to inspect for index status; default: the home page
